_comment: SCHEMATIC — target project indexes for the digitalmetrics module.
Deliberately empty. Every read this module performs is either a document
get by full path or a flat collection list, both of which Firestore serves
from single-field indexes with no configuration.
No composite index is listed because none is needed, and inventing
speculative ones costs storage and write latency for queries that do not
exist. Add an entry here only when a real query fails with a
FAILED_PRECONDITION telling you the index it wants.
Note that filtering by associate is impossible server-side by design:
associates are stored as HMAC tokens inside array elements, which
Firestore cannot index or query on. All per-associate filtering happens
